title: sync script: rr-cache restore is mutation-only — compliant 'git rerere' or direct postimage write replays ungated past gates; FATAL exit 2 leaves stale MERGE_HEAD
description:
Two verified gaps in llm_semantic_merge() in main's CURRENT scripts/sync-beads-workers.sh (four-dim pin: head_before/ref_before/merge_head_before/staged_before, kill-grace timeout -k 10). Surfaced by reviewer kimi-k3 edge-case pass on the beads-worker-2 rr-cache work, confirmed live on main.

FINDING 1 (P1, empirically reproduced): rr-cache is restored ONLY on the mutation/rewind path (the '[ -n "$why" ]' block, ~line 244-258). On the rc-gate / RESOLVED-sentinel / success paths the code just does 'rm -f "$session_log" "$rr_snap"' with NO rr-cache restore. Verified on git 2.54.0: in a conflicted --no-commit merge with rerere.enabled, a bare 'git rerere' (no args) records rr-cache/<id>/postimage IMMEDIATELY — no commit, no HEAD/ref/MERGE_HEAD/staged-set move, so it does NOT trip the four-dim mutation guard. A compliant LLM session that resolves then runs 'git rerere' (a standard conflict helper, neither required nor forbidden by the prompt) leaves its postimage behind; the NEXT sync's clean-merge path ('git merge --no-commit --no-ff' exits 0 via rerere replay) commits it with NO LLM gates at all (the marker/staged-set gates only run in llm_semantic_merge, which is skipped when the merge is clean). A malicious direct postimage write ('printf x > .git/rr-cache/*/postimage') has the same effect with zero git-state footprint. FIX: restore the pre-session rr-cache snapshot UNCONDITIONALLY on every exit path after the session (not just the mutation path), exactly as the mutation path already does (rm -rf rr-cache; if rr_had=1 tar -xf rr_snap). Same poisoning protection, and it ALSO eliminates the false-positive where a legit 'git rerere' would otherwise be indistinguishable from poisoning. The beads-worker-2 branch has a working reference (rr_restore() helper + unconditional call before the rc gate) and a 9-scenario sandbox harness under /tmp/opencode/d42k-head-pin/ (worker2) — do NOT merge that branch (it is 154 commits behind main); port the two-line restore onto main's structure.

FINDING 2 (P2): the FATAL 'exit 2' paths (detached-start, symbolic-ref repoint failure, reset --hard failure, rr-cache clear/restore failure — ~lines 226, 230, 240, 249, 254) exit with MERGE_HEAD/MERGE_MSG/MERGE_MODE potentially still present. If the mutation was rr-cache-only or the reset --hard failed only at the ref-update step (index/worktree already clean), the NEXT run's pre-loop .beads checkpoint ('git add .beads/ && git commit', ~line 343) sees a merge in flight and creates a MERGE commit with the worker branch as second parent but a tree of head_before + .beads only. Then 'git rev-list main..branch --count' returns 0 forever → the branch's real commits are silently never synced while the run reports success. FIX: on every FATAL exit path, also 'rm -f "$GIT_DIR"/MERGE_{HEAD,MSG,MODE}' before exit (and/or gate the pre-loop checkpoint on 'test ! -f "$GIT_DIR/MERGE_HEAD"').

Independent oracle for both fixes: the worker2 sandbox harness extracts the real functions and drives them with a stub 'opencode' covering commit/commit+reset-back/direct-postimage-write/git-rerere(reproduces Finding-1 false-positive)/replace-ref/merge-head-extra/checkout-b — all scenarios assert rc, HEAD, rr-cache postimage-wiped + preimage-preserved, and caller-abort safety.
close_reason: Fixed on beads-worker-2 (commit c023e5c90e, ported onto main's four-dimension pin structure via 'git checkout main --' baseline). FINDING 1: rr-cache now restored UNCONDITIONALLY on every post-session path (rr_restore helper called before the rc gate and in the mutation path) — a compliant 'git rerere' or direct postimage write no longer trips a false positive NOR persists poison; snapshot bytes held in shell memory (rr_snap_b64), not a same-UID-writable /tmp file (review round-1). FINDING 2: llm_merge_fatal fail-stop now clears MERGE_HEAD/MSG/MODE + removes stale index.lock + unstages the index (git reset -q) + wipes rr-cache + removes session_log before exit 2 — phantom-merge and staged-content-ride-checkpoint channels closed. BONUS defects found by harness/review and fixed: (a) git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD prints only FIRST line of multi-parent MERGE_HEAD — pin now cats full content (ancestry-injection caught); (b) MERGE_MSG added as fifth pin dimension (forged --no-edit message); (c) replace-ref subversion closed: GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 on all pin reads + rewind, session-created replace refs purged; (d) CHERRY_PICK_HEAD/REVERT_HEAD cleared post-session (forged author). Verified by 15-scenario sandbox harness (stub opencode; good/git_rerere/postimage_write/commit/commit_reset/checkout_b/stage_foreign/merge_head_extra/replace_ref/cherry_pick_plant/merge_msg_rewrite/rr_clear_fail/index_lock_fatal/detached_fatal + control) — 71 assertions ALL PASS against the committed file. Codereview: 4 rounds x 3 passes delegated to kimi-k3; rounds 1-3 produced 9 demonstrable findings (all fixed + harness-regressed); round 4: 3x PASS (convergence). Accepted residuals remain in nm0h (commented last round). Harness: /tmp/opencode/ndtl-main/harness.sh (worker2).
